assets.name: 余烬·水瓶
assets.detail: Crimson, ruby and rose-red palette only. Design 'scarlet cascade': bold angular waterfall made from TWO broad stepped flowing ribbons down each limb, one leading ribbon and a narrower offset return ribbon, with two generous tapered negative spaces, softened long bends and a few clean oblique transitions. NOT serrated or toothed. At the center, a sleek hourglass grasp is framed above and below by a low fan of three joined tapering folds, like water pouring over a lip. Two distinct shoulder fans lead seamlessly into long continuous blade bands. The palm has one diagonal inset red stripe, not a cage or star. Outer tips are slender curved pour-spouts meeting string anchors. Small red rhombus shards and short rose-red falling streak particles, understated.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: an original Aquarius zodiac bow concept for a Skyrim weapon mod collection. Produce ONE highly polished portrait 2:3 illustration of ONE full-length upright bow, centered on a pure black background. A near-orthographic three-quarter view exposes the solid thickness while preserving a clear silhouette, upper and lower limbs and BOTH tips fully visible with generous margins. Bowstring is one straight fine luminous line along the right, tied to the two tips. The grasp is centered and physically usable by one hand, with clear arrow passage on the string side. Elegant continuous sweeping geometric surfaces, thick beveled bands and clean limited facets, broadly balanced upper and lower limbs. All structural components physically connected; comfortable slim palm section, broad strong limbs. Material is solid colored magical light with darker saturated faces and narrow luminous edges; restrained soft glow, crisp geometry, no blown-out white surfaces. A few distinct glowing particles close to the limbs suggest draw effects, leave most background empty. Aquarius evoked abstractly by flowing and pouring geometry rather than a literal bottle. No characters, arrows, scenery, panels, titles, letters, numbers, logo or watermark. NO hexagram, pentagram, horn spikes, floating disconnected weapon parts, gears, mechanical hardware, metallic engraving, ornate filigree, chain of repeated tiny polygons or flimsy wire construction.

assets.name: 流萤·水瓶
assets.detail: Jade green, emerald and mint turquoise palette. Design 'jade current': exceptionally graceful flowing S-shaped main bow limbs, each a single WIDE ribbon sweeping outward then recurve inward, with one slender subordinate ribbon curling around a long teardrop-shaped opening at the shoulder, joined at both ends. Shape like a river stream poured from a vessel, not horns and not a leaf vine. The grasp has a soft twisted ergonomic profile and flowing asymmetrical wrap that continues organically into the limbs, no rectangular or angular cuffs. Split fish-tail tapered end integrated as one connected tip, one tip anchors the string. Subtle mint water-drop and tiny emerald round-mote particles in loose drifting groups.

assets.name: 寒汐·水瓶
assets.detail: Deep sapphire blue with cyan and ice-turquoise edges. Design 'ripple gate': limbs are long broad crescent blades with TWO nested clean open ripple arcs on the OUTSIDE of each limb, joined by only two short radial bridges. Spacious negative spaces, smooth circular arcs, no busy lattice, no ram horns or jagged mountain ridges. Central grip is a compact faceted oval spindle, widening into flattened semicircular pouring-lip shoulders above and below the hand; asymmetric sliced-circle openings in the shoulders, palm unobstructed. Short smoothly swept wedge tips. Sparse tiny cyan hollow rings and flat blue diamond particles, close to the bow, no huge glowing circle around whole weapon.

assets.name: 梦隙·水瓶
assets.detail: Rich violet and indigo faces with lavender and lilac luminous edges. Design 'violet confluence': two WIDE elegant ribbons braid around one another once along EACH bow limb, physically touching at their crossing and visibly separated in depth elsewhere, taper together into a graceful single elongated tip. Flowing negative space forms one elongated eye between the ribbons, neither a repeated DNA coil nor loose floating ribbons. Both bow shoulders curl gently outward like a wave crest while joining a distinctive narrow helical handgrip with a flattened smooth front palm surface, no separate cuffs, no angular fan. One secondary short curved fin grows organically from each shoulder. Palette entirely violet/lavender, no red. Sparse small crescent and slender lilac dash particles resembling tiny flowing tributaries, no smoke or giant halos.
